panels.label: 佩戴展示
panels.copy_purpose: 自然佩戴场景，突出正确佩戴位置与商品本体
panels.scene_prompt_en: Show the exact product naturally and correctly worn by one adult model at its category-appropriate body location.
panels.backdrop_en: Warm refined ivory interior, understated clothing, minimal cream decor.
panels.composition_en: Use the minimum body crop needed for the correct wearing location; place the product-bearing subject on the right two-thirds and keep the left side calm.
panels.lighting_en: Warm side-window light, natural skin, controlled highlights on metal, stones, and surface details.

panels.label: 结构全貌
panels.copy_purpose: 完整商品中突出可观察的结构、镶嵌、轮廓与表面细节
panels.scene_prompt_en: Show the exact complete item in a detail-led product photograph, using camera angle and light to document its most distinctive construction and surface details without cropping any part.
panels.backdrop_en: Pale warm marble with sparse translucent cream accents at the outer corners.
panels.composition_en: Keep the complete item and its full outer silhouette inside frame with breathing room; make the defining feature pin-sharp in the upper-middle and keep the lower area quiet.
panels.lighting_en: Soft raking daylight, crisp micro-contrast, realistic restrained highlights.

panels.label: 氛围静物
panels.copy_purpose: 暖调静物广告，突出商品质感和完整结构
panels.scene_prompt_en: Place the exact complete product in an intimate premium afternoon still life using an arrangement appropriate to its structure.
panels.backdrop_en: Warm walnut surface, edge of an open vintage book, one clear stemmed glass; sparse and believable.
panels.composition_en: Arrange the product clearly across the lower half and keep the upper-right clean.
panels.lighting_en: Amber late-afternoon window light with controlled product highlights.

panels.label: 礼赠展示
panels.copy_purpose: 无品牌礼盒或合适支撑上的完整礼赠陈列
panels.scene_prompt_en: Present the exact product on a correctly scaled premium unbranded jewelry support or box appropriate to this item.
panels.backdrop_en: Flowing ivory satin and one champagne ribbon confined to the outer edge.
panels.composition_en: Show the full product without bending or obstruction and retain a clean upper-left margin.
panels.lighting_en: Soft luminous daylight, warm ivory bounce, realistic controlled highlights.

panels.label: 镜面佩戴
panels.copy_purpose: 模特自然佩戴及物理一致的镜面生活方式展示
panels.scene_prompt_en: Create one complete photograph of the exact product correctly worn by one adult model standing before a real vertical mirror, with one faithful natural reflection in the same coherent scene.
panels.backdrop_en: Refined warm ivory dressing interior with a real champagne-framed mirror.
panels.composition_en: Keep model, reflection, mirror plane, visible limbs, and product comfortably in frame; reserve a quiet lower clothing or side area.
panels.lighting_en: Warm side-window light with believable reflection, perspective, and falloff.
